facts.P1_fx_receipts: Yes, but foreign currency must be surrendered to an approved bank.
facts.P2_fcy_account: Only with Finance Minister authorisation after a BCEAO opinion.
facts.P3_local_gateways: PayDunya offers mobile money and card collection; individual eligibility not confirmed.
facts.L1_registration: Declare as an entreprenant at the RCCM and get a NINEA before starting.
facts.L2_tax_id: NINEA, issued by the tax administration before you start.
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: Worldwide income taxed 0–43%; the CGU simplified regime excludes many freelance services.
facts.L4_vat_gst: 18% VAT; services taxed outside Senegal aren't taxable there.
facts.L5_data_protection: Law 2008-12: declare personal data processing to the CDP.
facts.L6_consumer_ecommerce: Electronic transactions law 2008-08 sets seller disclosure duties; no cooling-off confirmed.
facts.L7_incentives: Entreprenant status and the CGU simplified tax for non-BNC activities.

watch_out.text: Many freelance intellectual services count as BNC and can't use the CGU.
PayPal withdrawals to local banks are limited and fees are high.
Foreign-currency income from abroad must be surrendered to an approved bank.
